title: Κυρανίδες — Cyranides (Kyranides); RU: «Кираниды»
author: Anonymous (attributed to Hermes Trismegistus and Harpocration)
genre: Magical-medical natural history (stones, plants, birds, fish)
size: 4 books (plus 2 appended in Kaimakis); est. 40–50k words
edition: Kaimakis 1976 (critical; copyright). Ruelle and de Mély, Les lapidaires grecs, 1898 (partial Greek with French; public domain). Latin: Delatte 1942.
ru_evidence: No ru.wikipedia article; no Russian translation found in the checked catalogues (ΣΧΟΛΗ, Литпамятники).
en_evidence: en.wikipedia lists only a 1685 English version (from Latin) and Waegeman 1987 (selected Book 1 passages). No modern complete English.
other_translations: French: de Mély 1898 (partial text). German: Arabic Book 1, Toral-Niehoff 2004.
value: Key Hermetic handbook of amulets, love-magic, lapidary and bestiary lore, influential in Latin, Arabic and Old French. Its prologue (Harpocration's stele) matters for Hermetism. For historians of magic, religion, science and medieval reception.
ai_feasibility: medium-low: an unstable 'living text' with corrupt passages and rare names of stones, fish and plants. Uncertainty flags are mandatory; the editor checks against Kaimakis and the Latin.
pilot_unit: Book 1 prologue plus the first four letter-chapters (Α–Δ), est. 5–6k words
